title: nan
authors: Gross J.; De Petrillo M.; Beard J.; Nichols H.; Swiger T.; Watson R.; Kirk C.; Kilic C.; Hikes J.; Upton E.; Ross D.; Russell M.; Gu Y.; Griffin C.
key_contribution: Presents system design and field-testing of a cooperative UAV-UGV team where the UGV uses 3D LiDAR, fisheye camera, and UWB to map subterranean environments and track the UAV.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
